verses.pali: “Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo uppādetuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, an individual accomplished in view can’t give rise to six things.

verses.pali: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṁ, vicikicchaṁ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṁ, apāyagamanīyaṁ rāgaṁ, apāyagamanīyaṁ dosaṁ, apāyagamanīyaṁ mohaṁ.
verses.english: Substantialist view, doubt, misapprehension of precepts and observances, and forms of greed, hate, and delusion that lead to rebirth in places of loss.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo uppādetun”ti.
verses.english: An individual accomplished in view can’t give rise to these six things.”
